executive_summary_bullets: Submissions are concentrated around AI and Data domains, with a focus on watsonx.ai.
There is a strong emphasis on leveraging Astra DB for enterprise-grade RAG deployments.
Automation use cases highlight the need for efficient intake triage workflows.
Recurring themes include hybrid search and multi-modal RAG for regulated industries.
There is an opportunity to package these ideas into standardized accelerators for banking and insurance clients.
